verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης ἤκουσεν τὴν ἀκοὴν Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: En ekeinō tō kairō Hērōdēs ho tetraarchēs ēkousen tēn akoēn Iēsou
verses.literal: At that - time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς αὐτοῦ παισὶν Οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰωάννης ὁ Βαπτιστής αὐτὸς ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ τοῦτο διὰ αἱ δυνάμεις ἐνεργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai eipen tois autou paisin Houtos estin Iōannēs ho Baptistēs autos ēgerthē apo tōn nekrōn kai touto dia hai dynameis energousin en autō
verses.literal: and said to his servants This is John the Baptist he has risen from the dead - That is why - miraculous powers are at work in him

verses.original: γὰρ Ὁ Ἡρῴδης κρατήσας τὸν Ἰωάνην ἔδησεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέθετο ἐν φυλακῇ διὰ Ἡρῳδιάδα τὴν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Φιλίππου γυναῖκα
verses.transliteration: gar Ho Hērōdēs kratēsas ton Iōanēn edēsen auton kai apetheto en phylakē dia Hērōdiada tēn autou tou adelphou Philippou gynaika
verses.literal: [Now] - Herod had arrested - John [and] bound him and put [him] in prison on account of Herodias - his - brother Philip’s wife

verses.original: γὰρ Ἰωάννης ἔλεγεν αὐτῷ ὁ Οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἔχειν αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: gar Iōannēs elegen autō ho Ouk exestin soi echein autēn
verses.literal: because John had been telling him - vvv It is not lawful for you to have her

verses.original: καὶ θέλων ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτὸν ἐφοβήθη τὸν ὄχλον ὅτι εἶχον αὐτὸν ὡς προφήτην
verses.transliteration: kai thelōn apokteinai auton ephobēthē ton ochlon hoti eichon auton hōs prophētēn
verses.literal: Although [Herod] wanted to kill [John] he was afraid of the people because they regarded [John] as a prophet

verses.original: τοῦ Ἡρῴδου Γενεσίοις γενομένοις δὲ ἡ θυγάτηρ τῆς Ἡρῳδιάδος ὠρχήσατο ἐν τῷ μέσῳ καὶ ἤρεσεν τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ
verses.transliteration: tou Hērōdou Genesiois genomenois de hē thygatēr tēs Hērōdiados ōrchēsato en tō mesō kai ēresen tō Hērōdē
verses.literal: On Herod’s birthday . . . however the daughter - of Herodias danced before them . . . . . . and pleased - Herod

verses.original: ὅθεν ὡμολόγησεν μεθ’ ὅρκου δοῦναι αὐτῇ ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσηται
verses.transliteration: hothen hōmologēsen meth’ horkou dounai autē ho ean aitēsētai
verses.literal: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever . . . she asked

verses.original: δὲ προβιβασθεῖσα ὑπὸ αὐτῆς τῆς μητρὸς Ἡ φησίν Δός μοι Ὧδε ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάννου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de probibastheisa hypo autēs tēs mētros Hē phēsin Dos moi Hōde epi pinaki tēn kephalēn Iōannou tou Baptistou
verses.literal: - Prompted by her - mother - she said Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς λυπηθεὶς διὰ τοὺς ὅρκους καὶ τοὺς συνανακειμένους ἐκέλευσεν δοθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Kai ho basileus lypētheis dia tous horkous kai tous synanakeimenous ekeleusen dothēnai
verses.literal: - The king was grieved but because of [his] oaths and vvv his guests he ordered that [her wish] be granted

verses.original: καὶ πέμψας τὸν Ἰωάννην ἀπεκεφάλισεν ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ
verses.transliteration: kai pempsas ton Iōannēn apekephalisen en tē phylakē
verses.literal: and sent {to have} - John beheaded in the prison

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ κεφαλὴ ἠνέχθη ἐπὶ πίνακι καὶ ἐδόθη τῷ κορασίῳ καὶ ἤνεγκεν τῇ αὐτῆς μητρὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai autou hē kephalē ēnechthē epi pinaki kai edothē tō korasiō kai ēnenken tē autēs mētri
verses.literal: - [John’s] - head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl - [who] carried [it] to her mother

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ προσελθόντες ἦραν τὸ πτῶμα καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτόν καὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai autou hoi mathētai proselthontes ēran to ptōma kai ethapsan auton kai elthontes apēngeilan tō Iēsou
verses.literal: Then [John’s] - disciples came [and] took [his] body and buried it And they went [and] informed - Jesus

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀκούσας ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν ἐν πλοίῳ κατ’ ἰδίαν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἀκούσαντες ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πεζῇ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Akousas anechōrēsen ekeithen en ploiō kat’ idian eis erēmon topon kai hoi ochloi akousantes ēkolouthēsan autō pezē apo tōn poleōn
verses.literal: When - Jesus heard [ about John ] He withdrew . . . by boat vvv privately to a solitary place But the crowds found out [about it] [and] followed Him on foot from the towns

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτῶν τοὺς ἀρρώστους
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn eiden polyn ochlon kai esplanchnisthē ep’ autois kai etherapeusen autōn tous arrōstous
verses.literal: When He stepped ashore [and] saw a large crowd - He had compassion on them and healed their - sick

verses.original: δὲ Ὀψίας γενομένης οἱ μαθηταὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὁ ἐστιν Ἔρημός τόπος καὶ ἡ ὥρα ἤδη παρῆλθεν οὖν ἀπόλυσον τοὺς ὄχλους ἵνα ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὰς κώμας ἀγοράσωσιν ἑαυτοῖς βρώματα
verses.transliteration: de Opsias genomenēs hoi mathētai prosēlthon autō legontes ho estin Erēmos topos kai hē hōra ēdē parēlthen oun apolyson tous ochlous hina apelthontes eis tas kōmas agorasōsin heautois brōmata
verses.literal: When evening came the disciples came to Him [and] said This is a desolate place and the hour is already late . . . - Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages [and] buy themselves some food

verses.original: ἔχουσιν Οὐ χρείαν ἀπελθεῖν δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς δότε αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: echousin Ou chreian apelthein de Ho Iēsous eipen autois hymeis dote autois phagein
verses.literal: They do not need to go away - - Jesus replied - You give them [something] to eat

verses.original: Οὐκ ἔχομεν ὧδε εἰ μὴ πέντε ἄρτους καὶ δύο ἰχθύας δὲ Οἱ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ouk echomen hōde ei mē pente artous kai dyo ichthyas de Hoi legousin autō
verses.literal: - We have here only . . . five loaves of bread and two fish - - they answered -

verses.original: Φέρετέ αὐτούς ὧδε μοι δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Pherete autous hōde moi de Ho eipen
verses.literal: Bring them here to Me - - [Jesus] said

verses.original: καὶ κελεύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνακλιθῆναι ἐπὶ τοῦ χόρτου λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν καὶ κλάσας τοὺς ἄρτους ἔδωκεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις
verses.transliteration: kai keleusas tous ochlous anaklithēnai epi tou chortou labōn tous pente artous kai tous dyo ichthyas anablepsas eis ton ouranon eulogēsen kai klasas tous artous edōken tois mathētais de hoi mathētai tois ochlois
verses.literal: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass Taking the five loaves and the two fish [and] looking up to - heaven He spoke a blessing Then He broke the loaves [and] gave [them] to the disciples and the disciples [gave them] to the people

verses.original: Καὶ πάντες ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν καὶ ἦραν δώδεκα κοφίνους πλήρεις τῶν κλασμάτων τὸ περισσεῦον
verses.transliteration: Kai pantes ephagon kai echortasthēsan kai ēran dōdeka kophinous plēreis tōn klasmatōn to perisseuon
verses.literal: - vvv They all ate and were satisfied and [the disciples] picked up twelve basketfuls . . . - of broken pieces that were left over

verses.original: ὡσεὶ πεντακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες δὲ ἦσαν οἱ ἐσθίοντες χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων
verses.transliteration: hōsei pentakischilioi andres de ēsan hoi esthiontes chōris gynaikōn kai paidiōn
verses.literal: About five thousand men - were vvv fed besides women and children

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθέως ἠνάγκασεν τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐμβῆναι εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ προάγειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πέραν ἕως οὗ ἀπολύσῃ τοὺς ὄχλους
verses.transliteration: Kai eutheōs ēnankasen tous mathētas embēnai eis to ploion kai proagein auton eis to peran heōs hou apolysē tous ochlous
verses.literal: vvv Immediately [Jesus] made the disciples get into . . . the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side while . . . He dismissed the crowds

verses.original: καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος κατ’ ἰδίαν προσεύξασθαι δὲ ὀψίας γενομένης ἦν ἐκεῖ μόνος
verses.transliteration: kai apolysas tous ochlous anebē eis to oros kat’ idian proseuxasthai de opsias genomenēs ēn ekei monos
verses.literal: After He had dismissed [them] . . . . . . He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray When evening came He was there alone

verses.original: δὲ τὸ πλοῖον ἀπεῖχεν ἤδη πολλοὺς σταδίους ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς βασανιζόμενον ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων γὰρ ὁ ἄνεμος ἦν ἐναντίος
verses.transliteration: de to ploion apeichen ēdē pollous stadious apo tēs gēs basanizomenon hypo tōn kymatōn gar ho anemos ēn enantios
verses.literal: but the boat was already far . . . from - land buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it

verses.original: δὲ Τετάρτῃ φυλακῇ τῆς νυκτὸς ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς περιπατῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: de Tetartē phylakē tēs nyktos ēlthen pros autous peripatōn epi tēn thalassan
verses.literal: vvv During the fourth watch of the night [Jesus] went out to them walking on the sea

verses.original: δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐταράχθησαν ἐστιν Φάντασμά λέγοντες ὅτι καὶ ἔκραξαν ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου
verses.transliteration: de hoi mathētai idontes auton peripatounta epi tēs thalassēs etarachthēsan estin Phantasma legontes hoti kai ekraxan apo tou phobou
verses.literal: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea they were terrified It’s a ghost they said - and cried out in - fear

verses.original: δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Εὐθὺς λέγων ὁ Θαρσεῖτε εἰμι ἐγώ μὴ φοβεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: de Iēsous elalēsen autois Euthys legōn ho Tharseite eimi egō mē phobeisthe
verses.literal: But Jesus spoke up . . . at once - - Take courage It is I [Do] not be afraid

verses.original: Κύριε εἰ εἶ σὺ δὲ Πέτρος Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ὁ αὐτῷ κέλευσόν με ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα
verses.transliteration: Kyrie ei ei sy de Petros Apokritheis eipen ho autō keleuson me elthein pros se epi ta hydata
verses.literal: Lord if [it] is You - Peter replied . . . . . . . . . command me to come to You on the water

verses.original: Ἐλθέ δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν Καὶ Πέτρος καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ πλοίου ὁ περιεπάτησεν ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Elthe de Ho eipen Kai Petros katabas apo tou ploiou ho periepatēsen epi ta hydata kai ēlthen pros ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Come vvv vvv said [Jesus] Then Peter got down out of the boat - walked on the water and came toward - Jesus

verses.original: δὲ βλέπων τὸν ἰσχυρὸν ἄνεμον ἐφοβήθη καὶ ἀρξάμενος καταποντίζεσθαι ἔκραξεν λέγων Κύριε σῶσόν με
verses.transliteration: de blepōn ton ischyron anemon ephobēthē kai arxamenos katapontizesthai ekraxen legōn Kyrie sōson me
verses.literal: But when he saw the strength of the wind he was afraid and beginning to sink cried out - Lord save me

verses.original: δὲ Εὐθέως ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἐπελάβετο αὐτοῦ Ὀλιγόπιστε καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ εἰς τί ἐδίστασας
verses.transliteration: de Eutheōs ho Iēsous ekteinas tēn cheira epelabeto autou Oligopiste kai legei autō eis ti edistasas
verses.literal: - Immediately - Jesus reached out [His] hand [and] took hold of [Peter] [You] of little faith - He said - why . . . did you doubt

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτῶν ἀναβάντων εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ὁ ἄνεμος ἐκόπασεν
verses.transliteration: Kai autōn anabantōn eis to ploion ho anemos ekopasen
verses.literal: And when they had climbed back into the boat the wind died down

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες Ἀληθῶς εἶ Υἱὸς Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de hoi en tō ploiō prosekynēsan autō legontes Alēthōs ei Huios Theou
verses.literal: Then those who [were] in the boat worshiped Him saying Truly You are the Son of God

verses.original: Καὶ διαπεράσαντες ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν εἰς Γεννησαρέτ
verses.transliteration: Kai diaperasantes ēlthon epi tēn gēn eis Gennēsaret
verses.literal: When they had crossed over they landed . . . . . . . . . at Gennesaret

verses.original: καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἐκείνου τοῦ τόπου ἐπιγνόντες αὐτὸν ἀπέστειλαν εἰς ὅλην ἐκείνην τὴν περίχωρον καὶ προσήνεγκαν πάντας τοὺς ἔχοντας κακῶς αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hoi andres ekeinou tou topou epignontes auton apesteilan eis holēn ekeinēn tēn perichōron kai prosēnenkan pantas tous echontas kakōs autō
verses.literal: And when the men of that - place recognized [Jesus] they sent word to all - the surrounding region - [People] brought all the - sick to Him

verses.original: καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν μόνον ἵνα ἅψωνται τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ αὐτοῦ ἱματίου καὶ ὅσοι ἥψαντο διεσώθησαν
verses.transliteration: kai parekaloun auton monon hina hapsōntai tou kraspedou tou autou himatiou kai hosoi hēpsanto diesōthēsan
verses.literal: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak And all who touched [Him] were healed
